class StorageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(); self.addCleanup(self.temp.cleanup)
        self.base = Path(self.temp.name).resolve()
        self.source = self.base/'canonical'; self.source.mkdir(); (self.source/'level.dat').write_bytes(b'save')
        self.root = self.base/'profiles'; self.root.mkdir()
        self.world = self.root/'original/client/saves/ShaderLOD-Landscape'; self.world.mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.world/'level.dat').write_bytes(b'save'); (self.world/'session.lock').write_bytes(b'lock')
        self.report = self.base/'reports/release.json'; self.report.parent.mkdir(); self.report.write_text('{"zeroClients":true}')
        self.lock = (self.base/'lane.lock').open('a+'); self.addCleanup(self.lock.close)
        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        self.manifest = storage.create_manifest(self.root, [self.source], {})
        storage.register_clone(self.root, self.world)
        self.mutate(release=dict(children_reaped=True, authorized_owner=self.manifest['owner'], lane_lock=self.lock.name))
        self.process_inventory = storage.processes
        self.proc = mock.patch.object(storage, 'processes', return_value=[]); self.proc.start(); self.addCleanup(self.proc.stop)

    def mutate(self, **fields):
        marker = self.root/storage.MARKER
        data = json.loads(marker.read_text()); data.update(fields); storage.write(marker, data)

    def clean(self, **kwargs):
        return storage.cleanup(self.root, self.manifest['owner'], [self.report], self.lock, [43210], **kwargs)

    def test_real_tempfile_dry_run_and_opted_in_cleanup_retains_source_evidence(self):
        receipt = self.clean(); self.assertEqual(receipt['status'], 'dry-run'); self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())
        self.assertEqual(receipt['clones'][0]['bytes'], 8)
        receipt = self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.assertEqual(receipt['status'], 'complete'); self.assertFalse(self.world.exists())
        self.assertTrue((self.source/'level.dat').exists()); self.assertTrue(self.report.exists())
        self.assertTrue((self.root/storage.MARKER).exists())

    def test_destination_probe_and_exact_byte_reserve(self):
        space = mock.Mock(free=12)
        with mock.patch.object(storage.shutil, 'disk_usage', return_value=space) as usage:
            receipt = storage.capacity(self.base/'new/nested', 8, 4)
            usage.assert_called_once_with(self.base)
            self.assertEqual(receipt['required_bytes'], 12)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Insufficient destination'):
                storage.capacity(self.base/'new', 9, 4)
        self.assertFalse((self.base/'new').exists())

    def test_missing_release_bad_owner_and_lock_refused(self):
        self.mutate(release=None)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'release'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.mutate(owner='not-a-uuid')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'owner'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())

    def test_free_lane_lock_refused(self):
        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'hold lane lock'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())

    def test_clients_and_exact_launcher_group_refused(self):
        for row, message in [(dict(pid=44, session='44', command='java net.minecraft.client.main.Main'), 'Minecraft'),
                              (dict(pid=45, session='43210', command='Gradle child'), 'launcher')]:
            with mock.patch.object(storage, 'processes', return_value=[row]):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, message): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())

    def test_symlinks_escape_canonical_and_evidence_inside_clone_refused(self):
        link = self.world/'link'; link.symlink_to(self.source/'level.dat')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Symlink'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        link.unlink()
        self.mutate(disposable_world_clones=[dict(path=str(self.source), identity=storage.identity(self.source))])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'escape'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        storage.register_clone(self.root, self.world)
        self.mutate(disposable_world_clones=[dict(path=str(self.world), identity=storage.identity(self.world))], canonical_inputs=[str(self.world)])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Canonical'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.mutate(canonical_inputs=[str(self.source)])
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Evidence inside'):
            storage.cleanup(self.root, self.manifest['owner'], [self.world/'level.dat'], self.lock, [43210], False)

    def test_missing_evidence_identity_drift_and_inventory_limit(self):
        self.report.unlink()
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Missing retained evidence'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.report.write_text('{}')
        self.mutate(root_identity=dict(device=-1, inode=-1))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'identity'): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        with mock.patch.object(storage, 'MAX_ENTRIES', 0):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'limit'): storage.inventory(self.source)

    def test_copy_inventory_cache_requires_readmitted_fingerprint(self):
        storage._WORLD_BYTES.clear()
        profile = self.base/'template'; profile.mkdir(); (profile/'options.txt').write_bytes(b'abc')
        with mock.patch.object(storage, 'inventory', wraps=storage.inventory) as scan:
            first = storage.copy_requirement(profile, self.source, 'a'*64, 3, ())
            second = storage.copy_requirement(profile, self.source, 'a'*64, 3, ())
            self.assertEqual(first['bytes'], 21); self.assertEqual(first, second)
            self.assertEqual(scan.call_count, 3)

    def test_write_failure_prevents_real_delete(self):
        with mock.patch.object(storage, 'write', side_effect=OSError('no room for evidence')):
            with self.assertRaises(OSError): self.clean(dry_run=False)
        self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())

    def test_actual_sid_catches_descendant_in_different_process_group(self):
        output = mock.Mock(stdout='800 900 java descendant\n')
        with mock.patch.object(storage.subprocess, 'run', return_value=output), \
             mock.patch.object(storage.os, 'getsid', return_value=43210) as sid, \
             mock.patch.object(storage, 'processes', side_effect=self.process_inventory):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Active launcher session'):
                self.clean(dry_run=False)
            sid.assert_called_once_with(800)
        self.assertTrue(self.world.exists())

    def test_session_probe_exit_race_and_access_failure(self):
        output = mock.Mock(stdout='800 900 java descendant\n')
        with mock.patch.object(storage.subprocess, 'run', return_value=output):
            with mock.patch.object(storage.os, 'getsid', side_effect=ProcessLookupError):
                self.assertEqual(self.process_inventory(), [])
            with mock.patch.object(storage.os, 'getsid', side_effect=PermissionError):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Cannot verify actual process session'):
                    self.process_inventory()

    def test_documented_relative_prepare_cli_with_tiny_saved_plan_inputs(self):
        # Three saved plans use the same fields/argv consumed by the authentic
        # Bliss renderer recipe; payloads and dependency APIs are tiny fixtures.
        template = self.base/'template'; template.mkdir()
        pack = self.base/'Bliss_v2.1.2.zip'; pack.write_bytes(b'fixture-pack')
        review = self.base/'source-review.md'; review.write_text('Fixture source evidence')
        sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        worldmap = {'level.dat': sha(self.source/'level.dat')}
        for arm in recipe.ARMS:
            prior = self.base/'templates'/arm/'client'
            (prior/'config').mkdir(parents=True); (prior/'mods').mkdir()
            (prior/'config/shaderlod-client.toml').write_text('[lod]\nenabled=false\n')
            (prior/'options.txt').write_text('renderDistance:24\n')
            stage = template/arm; stage.mkdir()
            for name, data in [('options.txt','QUALITY=3\n'), ('core.toml','[lod]\nenabled=false\n'),
                               ('control.json','{"x":256.5,"time":7000}'), ('expected-options.json','{"QUALITY":"3"}')]:
                (stage/name).write_text(data)
            plan = dict(profile=str(prior), pack=pack.name, pack_name=pack.name, sourceReview=review.name,
                        command=[str(self.base/'gradlew'), 'runClientLodOff', '-PrunDirectory='+str(prior),
                                 '-PcontrolCaptureReceipt='+str(stage/'captures')])
            storage.write(stage/'plan.json', plan)
            storage.write(stage/'freeze.json', dict(build={}, canonicalWorld=worldmap,
                          files={str(stage/'plan.json'):sha(stage/'plan.json')}))
        client = mock.Mock()
        client.runtime_lock.side_effect = contextlib.nullcontext
        client.clients.return_value = {}; client.build_fingerprint.return_value = {}
        observed = []
        def consume(plan, backup):
            observed.append(plan)
            for key in ('profile', 'installed_pack', 'pack', 'pack_options', 'expected_options_source', 'sourceReview'):
                self.assertTrue(Path(plan[key]).is_absolute(), key)
            self.assertTrue(Path(backup).is_absolute())
        client.prepare.side_effect = consume
        prior_cwd = Path.cwd()
        try:
            os.chdir(self.base)
            argv = ['renderer_average_storage.py', 'prepare', '--template', 'template', '--world', 'canonical',
                    '--profiles', 'run-workloads/cli-next', '--output', 'reports/cli-next']
            with mock.patch.object(recipe, 'load_client', return_value=client), \
                 mock.patch.object(storage.shutil, 'disk_usage', return_value=mock.Mock(free=2 * 1024 ** 3)), \
                 mock.patch.object(sys, 'argv', argv), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                recipe.main()
        finally:
            os.chdir(prior_cwd)
        profiles = self.base/'run-workloads/cli-next'; output = self.base/'reports/cli-next'
        manifest = json.loads((profiles/storage.MARKER).read_text())
        self.assertEqual(len(manifest['disposable_world_clones']), 3)
        self.assertEqual(manifest['root'], str(profiles))
        self.assertEqual(len(observed), 3)
        for arm in recipe.ARMS:
            world = profiles/arm/'client/saves'/recipe.WORLD
            self.assertEqual((world/'level.dat').read_bytes(), b'save')
            generated = json.loads((output/arm/'plan.json').read_text())
            self.assertIn('-PrunDirectory='+str(profiles/arm/'client'), generated['command'])
            self.assertIn('-PcontrolCaptureReceipt='+str(output/arm/'captures'), generated['command'])
            freeze = json.loads((output/arm/'freeze.json').read_text())
            self.assertTrue(all(Path(name).is_absolute() for name in freeze['files']))

    def test_adapter_default_preserve_and_boundary_pin(self):
        recipe.dispose(None, None, None, False)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'Frozen renderer runner'):
            recipe.adapted_runner('changed', self.base, self.report.parent, False)

import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bsl_binding_caller',ROOT/'scripts/run_bsl_binding_comparison.py')
caller=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(caller)
OLD=ROOT/'dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/bsl-prefix-binding-hotpath-cost-r20'

class BslBindingCallerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actual_failure_separates_request_capture_stop(self):
        if not (OLD/'sequence.json').exists():self.skipTest('Retained authentic failure unavailable')
        report=caller.recorded_failure(OLD)
        self.assertTrue(report['requestExists'])
        self.assertNotIn('Missing protocol capture request receipt',report['errors'])
        self.assertIn('Strict native capture receipt is not saved-observations',report['errors'])
        self.assertIn('Missing exact automatic deadline-stop completion',report['errors'])
        self.assertFalse(report['measurementAccepted'])
        self.assertTrue(any('ShaderPackScreen' in row for row in report['nativeUiRows']))

    def test_legacy_ui_endpoint_cannot_admit_startup(self):
        if not (OLD/'original/console.log').exists():self.skipTest('Authentic console unavailable')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'No fresh native startup'):
            caller.current_ui((OLD/'original/console.log').read_text())

    def test_actual_source_startup_message_shape(self):
        source=(ROOT/'src/devClient/java/com/pp/shaderlod/dev/ComparisonClient.java').read_text()
        self.assertIn('ShaderLOD capture readiness: tick={}',source)
        # Parser contract only, no runtime/GL positive: captures reject their own state independently.
        line='ShaderLOD capture readiness: tick=40, focused=true, paused=false, screen=none, fullscreen=true, framebuffer=1920x1200, target=1920x1200, monitor=1'
        self.assertEqual(caller.current_ui(line)[1:5],('true','false','none','true'))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):caller.current_ui(line.replace('tick=40','tick=600'))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):caller.current_ui(line.replace('monitor=1','monitor=unknown'))

    def test_preflight_batches_old_metadata_before_build(self):
        class NoBuild:
            def build_fingerprint(self):raise AssertionError('Metadata errors must precede built hashing')
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            session=Path(tmp)
            p=json.loads((OLD/'cost-original-plan.json').read_text()) if (OLD/'cost-original-plan.json').exists() else {'command':[]}
            p.update(parent_profile_preparation_pending=True,source_direct_task=False,profile='relative',arm='original')
            p['command']+=['-PsettledConsumerUniforms=false','-PcompositeCopyWitness=false']
            (session/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(p))
            result=caller.preflight(session,'diagnostic',NoBuild())
            self.assertFalse(result['admitted'])
            self.assertGreaterEqual(len(result['errors']),5)
            self.assertTrue(any('settledConsumerUniforms' in x for x in result['errors']))
            self.assertTrue(any('compositeCopyWitness' in x for x in result['errors']))

    def test_no_main_actual_json_null_convention(self):
        absent={'coreConfigStatus':'absent: main mod not loaded in Off task','coreConfig':None}
        self.assertTrue(caller.stock_core_absent(absent))
        self.assertTrue(caller.stock_core_absent({'coreConfigStatus':absent['coreConfigStatus']}))  # Actual Gson omits JsonNull member.
        self.assertFalse(caller.stock_core_absent(dict(absent,coreConfig={})))

    def test_async_capture_waits_for_saved_and_rejects_failed(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            p=Path(tmp)/'receipt.json'
            self.assertIsNone(caller.capture_status(p))
            p.write_text('{');self.assertIsNone(caller.capture_status(p))
            p.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'capture-requested'}));self.assertEqual(caller.capture_status(p),'capture-requested')
            p.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'saved-observations'}));self.assertEqual(caller.capture_status(p),'saved-observations')
            p.write_text(json.dumps({'status':'failed'}))
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'no retry'):caller.capture_status(p)

    def test_after_action_needs_new_tick_and_strict_ui(self):
        line='ShaderLOD capture readiness: tick=40, focused=true, paused=false, screen=none, fullscreen=true, framebuffer=1920x1200, target=1920x1200, monitor=1'
        prior=caller.current_ui(line)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'No newer'):caller.fresh_ui_after(prior,line)
        newer=line.replace('tick=40','tick=60')
        self.assertEqual(caller.fresh_ui_after(prior,newer)[0],'60')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Fresh native UI'):caller.fresh_ui_after(prior,newer.replace('screen=none','screen=net.irisshaders.iris.gui.screen.ShaderPackScreen'))

    def test_diagnostic_uses_no_runtime_input_status_not_b_quality(self):
        diagnostic=ROOT/'dev/logs/cross-shader-performance-r3/bsl-binding-original-readiness-20261011'
        if not (diagnostic/'plan.json').exists():self.skipTest('Actual prepared diagnostic unavailable')
        p=json.loads((diagnostic/'plan.json').read_text());freeze=json.loads((diagnostic/'freeze.json').read_text())
        # Authentic incomplete input is a negative: never manufacture a runnable world/GL fixture.
        if not freeze.get('worlds',{}).get('cloneWorld'):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Empty original world'):
                caller.validate_original_diagnostic(p,freeze)
        else:
            wrong=dict(freeze,status='parent-frozen-after-source-motion-admission')
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,'Explicit original-input diagnostic'):
                caller.validate_original_diagnostic(p,wrong)
        scene=caller.original_scene(p)
        self.assertEqual(scene['cameraX'],p['scene_input']['x'])
        self.assertFalse(scene['dhPresent'])

            self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(weights), 9)
            for axis in (0,1):
                self.assertAlmostEqual(sum(p[axis]*q for p,q in zip(offsets,weights)), 0)
                moment = sum(p[axis]**2*q/9 for p,q in zip(offsets,weights))

            det = a*d-b*c
            if abs(det) < .05:
                continue
            hx,hy = .01,.03
            ex,ey = (abs(d)*hx+abs(c)*hy)/abs(det), (abs(b)*hx+abs(a)*hy)/abs(det)
            for x in (-hx,hx):
                for y in (-hy,hy):

def f32(x):
    return struct.unpack("f", struct.pack("f", x))[0]


def accumulate(opacities, densities, threshold, permission):
    """Native positive-add recurrence, not a texture/raster/GPU emulator."""
    value, density, first = 0.0, 0.0, True
    visited = []
    for i, opacity in enumerate(opacities):
        visited.append(i)
        if opacity > 0.0:
            value = f32(value + opacity)
            if first:
                first, density = False, densities[i]
        if permission == 1.0 and 0.0 < threshold < 1e30 and value >= threshold:
            break
    return (min(max(f32(value / threshold), 0.0), 1.0),
            min(max(density, 0.0001), 1.0)), visited

        compiler = shutil.which("clang")
        if compiler is None:
            self.skipTest("clang C preprocessor unavailable; this is not an Iris test")
        # GLSL versions and plain properties comments are not C directives.
        source = re.sub(r"^\s*#(?:version|extension)\b.*$", "", source, flags=re.M)

        prefix = "".join(f"#define {key} {value}\n" for key, value in defines.items())
        result = subprocess.run([compiler, "-E", "-P", "-x", "c", "-",
                                 "-Wno-invalid-pp-token", "-Wno-macro-redefined"],
                                input=prefix + source, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
        return result.stdout

def preprocess(files, mode=0, extra=None, dimension='world0', dof=False, aa=2, bloom=True):
    def expand(name):
        return re.sub(r'^\s*#include\s+"(/[^\"]+)"\s*$',
                      lambda match: expand('shaders' + match[1]), files[name].decode(), flags=re.M)
    source = expand(f'shaders/{dimension}/composite1.fsh')
    source = source.replace('#define ' + m.OPTION + ' 0', '#define ' + m.OPTION + ' ' + str(mode))
    source = source.replace('// #define DOF ', '#define DOF ' if dof else '// #define DOF ')
    source = source.replace('#define AA_TYPE 2 ', '#define AA_TYPE ' + str(aa) + ' ')
    if not bloom:
        source = source.replace('#define BLOOM //', '// #define BLOOM //')
    source = re.sub(r'^\s*#(?:version|extension).*$', '', source, flags=re.M)
    macros = {'IS_IRIS': 1, 'IRIS_VERSION': 10812, 'MC_VERSION': 12101}
    macros.update(extra or {})
    macros = {k: v for k, v in macros.items() if v is not None}
    result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/clang', '-E', '-P', '-x', 'c'] +
                            [f'-D{k}={v}' for k, v in macros.items()] + ['-'],
                            input=source, text=True, capture_output=True, check=True)
    return result.stdout


def cell(coords, radius, size):
    lo = [(c - r) * s - .5 for c, r, s in zip(coords, radius, size)]
    hi = [(c + r) * s - .5 for c, r, s in zip(coords, radius, size)]
    return all(l >= .01 and h <= s - 1.01 and math.floor(l - .01) == math.floor(h + .01)
               for l, h, s in zip(lo, hi, size))


def taps(v):
    x, y = v
    return [(x, y), (-x, -y), (-1.25*y, 1.25*x), (1.25*y, -1.25*x)]


def filtered(values, uv, bits=None):
    x, y = uv
    if bits:
        x, y = round(x * 2**bits) / 2**bits, round(y * 2**bits) / 2**bits
    a, b, c, d = values
    return (a*(1-x) + b*x)*(1-y) + (c*(1-x) + d*x)*y


def quantize_hdr(value, mantissa):
    # Positive normal R11F/G11F/B10F domain used by the native bloom source.
    if value == 0:
        return value
    exponent = max(-14, math.floor(math.log2(value)))
    step = 2**(exponent - mantissa)
    return round(value / step) * step

    def test_bilinear_moment_identity_quantized_hdr_and_trilinear(self):
        rng = random.Random(10)
        largest = 0.0
        quantized_max = 0.0
        for _ in range(12000):
            x, y = rng.uniform(.15, .85), rng.uniform(.15, .85)
            v = (rng.uniform(-.1, .1), rng.uniform(-.1, .1))
            offsets = taps(v)
            pair = [(v[0]*.75, v[1]*-.375), (-v[0]*.75, v[1]*.375)]
            native, paired, nq, pq = [], [], [], []
            for level in range(2):

                native.append(sum(filtered(values, (x+dx, y+dy)) for dx, dy in offsets) / 4)
                paired.append(sum(filtered(values, (x+dx, y+dy)) for dx, dy in pair) / 2)
                nq.append(sum(filtered(values, (x+dx, y+dy), 8) for dx, dy in offsets) / 4)

def f(x):
    return struct.unpack('f', struct.pack('f', x))[0]


def add(a, b):
    return tuple(f(x + y) for x, y in zip(a, b))


def mul(a, k):
    return tuple(f(x * k) for x in a)


def project(p, py=1.4):
    return (f(f(f(p[0] / -p[2]) * .5) + .5),
            f(f(f(f(py * p[1]) / -p[2]) * .5) + .5),
            f(f(f(f(-1.002 * p[2]) - .1001) / -p[2]) * .5 + .5))


def zero_tail(p, d, err, py=1.4):
    edge = f(f(py * err[1]) + err[2])
    slope = f(1e-5 * f(f(f(py * abs(d[1])) + abs(d[2])) + 1))
    return (p[2] < -err[2] and d[2] <= 0 and
            f(f(py * p[1]) + p[2]) > edge and f(f(py * d[1]) + d[2]) > slope)


def trace(h, d, jitter, mode, enabled):
    p = h
    sp = project(p)
    prev = sp[2]
    hitdepth = prev
    search = hidden = out = far = hiddens = False
    count = 0
    diff = 1
    err = tuple(f(.0001 * f(f(abs(x) + f(abs(v) * 2048)) + 1)) for x, v in zip(h, d))
    for i in range(10):
        if enabled and i > 0 and not search and out and sp[1] > 1 and zero_tail(p, d, err):
            return sp, 1.0, 10-i
        if search:
            inc = mul(inc, .5)
            p = add(p, mul(inc, 1 if diff > 0 else -1 if diff < 0 else 0))
        else:
            old = p
            p = add(h, add(mul(d, f(2 ** f(i+jitter))), mul(d, -1)))
            inc = add(p, mul(old, -1))
        last = sp
        sp = project(p)
        out |= sp[0] < 0 or sp[0] > 1 or sp[1] < 0 or sp[1] > 1 or sp[2] < 0
        far |= sp[2] > .9999
        # Several bounded depth fields, including discontinuities and sky misses.
        if mode == 0:
            depth = 1.0
        elif mode == 1:
            depth = .99 if int(abs(sp[0] * 127)) % 7 == 0 else 1.0
        elif mode == 2:
            depth = f(.95 + .05 * min(max(sp[1], 0), 1))
        else:
            depth = f(.9 + .1 * ((int(abs(sp[0]*63)) ^ int(abs(sp[1]*63))) % 17) / 16)
        diff = f(depth-sp[2])
        if diff < 0 and abs(f(depth-prev)) > abs(f(sp[2]-last[2])):
            hidden = hiddens = True
        elif diff > 0:
            hidden = False
            if not hiddens:
                count += 1
        if not search and diff < 0 and not hidden:
            search = True
        prev = depth
    infinite = float(depth > .9999)
    if out:
        infinite = 1
    elif far and depth <= .9999 and count >= 3 and depth <= hitdepth:
        infinite = 1
        sp = (1., 1., 1.)
    return sp, infinite, 0
